nodes.label: API Client
nodes.rationale: Typed fetch functions + ApiError class; adds /api/v1 prefix, unwraps json.data from the { success, data, meta } envelope, reads json.error.message.

nodes.label: generate-agent-files.js
nodes.rationale: The agent-rules block is written and re-added by next dev; committing it with your work keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Audit Logs Module
nodes.rationale: Read-only GET /audit-logs endpoint with filters; left-joins user selecting safe fields (no passwordHash); not yet wired into services.

nodes.label: Frontend (Next.js 16)
nodes.rationale: Monorepo admin-hp/backend + admin-hp/frontend; Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TailwindCSS v4; pages for login, dashboard, POS, products, inventory, sales, returns, reports.

nodes.label: NestJS Backend
nodes.rationale: Backend stack is Node.js + NestJS + TypeORM against PostgreSQL with JWT auth; modules live on disk under smartstore-backend/.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL 15.19 via Homebrew at /usr/local/var/postgresql@15; database smartstore; all 4 migrations executed (26 tables), all seeders run.

nodes.label: Reports/Dashboard
nodes.rationale: 8 report endpoints built with raw SQL via DataSource: sales-summary, sales-by-product, sales-by-cashier, payment-breakdown, gross-profit, stock-on-hand, stock-movements, returns-summary.

nodes.label: Response Envelope
nodes.rationale: { success, data, meta } for success; { success:false, error:{code,message,details} } for errors; response-transform interceptor only flattens when both data and meta present.

nodes.label: User Roles
nodes.rationale: Five roles: OWNER, ADMIN, CASHIER, INVENTORY, SUPERVISOR; enforced via JWT + RolesGuard on endpoints.

nodes.label: Settings Module
nodes.rationale: Key-value app_settings CRUD with per-key validators; bulk update via PATCH /settings restricted to OWNER/ADMIN.

nodes.label: SmartStore POS & Inventory
nodes.rationale: Single-store smartphone shop POS & inventory system; focus on IMEI-level traceability for phones, fast checkout, accurate stock movement, and daily profit visibility. 8-week MVP, IDR currency, English UI.

nodes.label: node_modules/next/dist/docs Guide
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data, so agents must read the bundled docs before writing code.

nodes.label: Repo Hygiene Review
nodes.rationale: session-ses_ff90.md at the repo root should be gitignored; backend/.env tracking must be verified; root readme lacks extension; confirm node_modules and dist/ are ignored.

nodes.label: IMEI Tracking
nodes.rationale: IMEI status lifecycle (in_stock, sold, returned, defective) drives serialized inventory correctness; status transitions happen on receipt, sale, void, and return.

nodes.label: Migrations
nodes.rationale: Four migrations: 0001-init-schema, 0002-inventory-schema, 0003-sales-schema, 0004-returns-schema; executed successfully creating 26 tables.

nodes.label: POS Checkout
nodes.rationale: Enhanced checkout: INV-YYYYMMDD-NNNN invoice numbering, pagination/filters, void sale with stock reversal, change calculation, customer validation.

nodes.label: Receiving Workflow
nodes.rationale: Procurement to receiving to stock pipeline: validates PO status and qty, registers IMEI units for serialized items, creates stock_movements, updates stock_balances and PO status, auto-generates GRN number.

nodes.label: Returns/Refunds
nodes.rationale: Validate + create + list return flow: eligibility checks, IMEI status update, RETURN_IN/ADJUST_IN movements, refund methods (cash, bank transfer, store credit), restock types (sellable, defective).

nodes.label: Progressive Discovery
nodes.rationale: Agents are given only memory names initially and start from the top-level entry point (mem:core graph root), progressively discovering memories through mem: references whose depth depends on project complexity.
